title: Deutsche Post & Rail Logistics: Multi-Region Hybrid Cloud Migration
challenge: Client operated 450 legacy VMware on-premise virtual machines with increasing hardware maintenance costs, unscalable batch processing during peak holiday seasons, and zero multi-region disaster recovery.
solution: Tychon Software designed and executed a 7-stage migration strategy using AWS Application Migration Service and automated Terraform infrastructure modules. Re-architected monolithic scheduling into microservices hosted on Amazon EKS (Kubernetes) with automated Istio service mesh and GitOps pipelines via ArgoCD.
outcomes: Achieved zero-downtime cutover across 8 critical European transport nodes, reduced recurring operational cloud spend by 35%, and guaranteed 99.99% availability during peak freight traffic.

title: Apollo Healthcare Consortium: HIPAA-Compliant Data Lakehouse & AI Analytics
challenge: Siloed patient health records across 60 hospital facilities led to multi-minute query latency, inability to run population health analytics, and compliance friction with DISHA and HIPAA privacy mandates.
solution: Tychon Software built a centralized, encrypted Data Lakehouse on Azure Databricks with Delta Lake. Implemented field-level tokenization, automated role-based access control (RBAC), and streaming ETL pipelines processing real-time HL7 and FHIR clinical feeds.
outcomes: Consolidated 15 million clinical records, cut analytic query execution time by 96%, and enabled real-time predictive bed occupancy models with full HIPAA/DISHA data governance.

title: Stockholm Retail & FinServices: Core Banking Microservices Modernization
challenge: Legacy monolithic payment processing engine suffered from slow bi-monthly release cycles, high blast radius during production incidents, and inability to meet strict PCI-DSS audit segregation guidelines.
solution: Decomposed monolithic codebase into 28 domain-driven microservices using Spring Boot and Java 21. Deployed onto multi-tenant Kubernetes clusters with Kong API Gateway, mTLS encryption, and distributed tracing via OpenTelemetry.
outcomes: Scaled transactions to 25,000 requests/second with p99 latency under 50ms, achieved full PCI-DSS Level 1 compliance verification, and boosted deployment frequency by 14x.

title: Nordic Telecom Platform: GitOps CI/CD & Security Hardening
challenge: Manual release approvals and disparate pipeline tooling resulted in security scan delays, undocumented configuration drift, and slow incident remediation.
solution: Implemented enterprise-wide GitOps architecture using GitLab CI, ArgoCD, and automated vulnerability scanning gates (Trivy, SonarQube, Snyk). Enforced immutable infrastructure and cryptographic image signing with Cosign.
outcomes: Reduced Mean Time To Recovery (MTTR) by 68%, automated all ISO 27001 release audit trails, and established zero-touch staging-to-production promotions.
